notes: Same method as 20260904: one dedicated chrome-devtools MCP page (isolatedContext 'vals-ai-rescrape-20260906'), every benchmark fetched with the page's own absolute-URL fetch() inside evaluate_script, HTML parsed with DOMParser, <astro-island> props JSON unwrapped recursively from Astro's [typeCode, value] form (type 1 = array, type 0 = value; plain objects are descended into as well). No value was altered.

The full-data island is the one whose props contain '"benchmarkView":[0,{"default":' -- it alone carries stderr, latency, cost_per_test, sampling params and the subtask breakdowns. The ScatterGraph/BarGraph islands on the same page carry a benchmarkView WITHOUT the 'default' wrapper and silently drop stderr; they were skipped as the main payload. stderr survived: 2776 of 2816 records carry it, and the only 40 without it are the 40 RSI Index rows, whose page publishes no stderr. Every non-RSI record has stderr.

DEEPER THAN 20260904 -- fields added this run, none removed: per-model sampling/harness fields temperature, top_p, reasoning, reasoning_effort, verbosity, compute_effort, harness; benchmark-level benchmark_id, benchmark_family, benchmark_version, dataset_type, industry, runner, mode; a nested 'subtasks' object holding every non-overall task's full per-model metric block (2214 of 2816 records have one); a nested 'languages' object holding the per-language accuracy/count breakdown published only for Code Migration (56 records).

raw.json additionally keeps, per benchmark under 'extras': the version-selector island ('versions'), the company/model timeline island with historical points and projections ('companies'), per-model auxiliary data islands ('model_data'), cost/score curve islands ('curves'), the per-benchmark language breakdown ('language_breakdown'), and any other non-benchmarkView island verbatim under 'island_<propkeys>'. A top-level '_nav' key holds the /benchmarks nav listing, which now carries an 'industry' tag per benchmark. Duplicate chart islands that repeat benchmarkView without 'default' are dropped as redundant and stderr-less.
Record grain is unchanged from 20260904 (one record per model per benchmark, from the 'overall' task) so row counts stay comparable; subtask numbers ride along nested rather than as extra rows.

rank is recomputed locally per benchmark by sorting the overall accuracy descending; cost_usd is cost_per_test (USD per test case); latency_s is the site's latency in seconds; null fields are omitted per record. context_window is still unpublished on vals.ai and absent from every record.

Model ids keep the site's provider/model form (e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-5). Display names are not published in the payload and are not guessed. RSI Index rows are the exception: that page publishes display names only ('Claude Fable 5.1 (max)').
raw.json is keyed by URL path slug; normalized.json's benchmark_slug uses each payload's own metadata.slug, which can still differ (web_search's metadata.slug is 'web_search_backends').

45 slugs were fetched directly rather than trusting the nav (the nav lists fewer). 0 fetch errors. Finance Agent v1.1 ('finance_agent') and Terminal-Bench 1.0 ('terminal-bench') are still off-nav but still resolve HTTP 200 with full payloads and are included. 'reverse_eng' still 302-redirects to /benchmarks/srebench and was dropped as a duplicate of srebench, leaving 44 distinct benchmarks.

Page-pointer contention from the other concurrently running scraper agents caused roughly 60 wasted select_page/evaluate_script turns. Every script guarded location.href and threw WRONG_PAGE:<href> rather than returning an error object, so no guard output was ever written as data; every saved file's size on disk was checked afterwards.
